scope: Exterior tonal balance and warm lighting direction
partialApproval.meaning: The user approved continuing from this exterior and lighting direction; this is not final approval of the complete asset.

pipeline.description: Declared code adjunct: a measured front opening, an inferred user-requested rear opening under review and an inner-shell opening aligned to the existing door window, plus room, timber floor and two candle sources. The door cut stops before its imported panes and divisions. This declaration does not prove arbitrary executable support. The selected D3DMESH1 geometry and UV source remain unchanged.

distribution: Metadata only. Private generated models, textures and game extracts are not distributed by this manifest.
